WITH vendedores AS (
    SELECT 
        s.seller_id,
        SUM(oi.price) AS ingresos,
        AVG(rv.review_score) AS calificacion,
        SUM(CASE WHEN er.entrega_con_retraso = 1 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) * 100.0 / COUNT(er.order_id) AS pct_retrasos
    FROM 
        sellers s
    JOIN 
        order_items oi ON s.seller_id = oi.seller_id
    JOIN 
        vw_pedidos_validos o ON oi.order_id = o.order_id
    LEFT JOIN 
        order_reviews rv ON o.order_id = rv.order_id
    LEFT JOIN 
        vw_entregas_retrasos er ON o.order_id = er.order_id
    GROUP BY 
        s.seller_id
    HAVING 
        COUNT(DISTINCT oi.order_id) >= 30
),
vendedores_ordenados AS (
    SELECT 
        seller_id,
        ingresos,
        calificacion,
        pct_retrasos,
        ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY ingresos DESC) AS rank_ingresos,
        COUNT(*) OVER () AS total_vendedores
    FROM 
        vendedores
)
SELECT 
    COUNT(*) AS num_vendedores,
    SUM(ingresos) AS ingresos_totales
FROM 
    vendedores_ordenados
WHERE 
    rank_ingresos <= total_vendedores * 0.25
    AND (calificacion < 3.5 OR pct_retrasos >= 15)
